newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products - gas oil gains, fuel oil steady.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products - gas oil gains, fuel oil steady.

text.p: NWE oil products were mildly positive on Wednesday morning, as gas oil ticked up and fuel oil was steady, dealers said.

Gas oil gained $1 after slightly bullish U.S. stock figures. Stocks were up 660,000 barrels week-on-week, but fell by a million barrels on the east coast. Heating oil offers were at Dec IPE +$2.50 fob ARA for both end November and early December. Demand remained patchy
High sulphur fuel oil barges traded three times at $119 fob ARA for early December delivery, with offers later at $120. Late Nov deliveries were 50 cents to $1 lower. Bunker demand grew.
